correctness.rationale: Exact 14-dimensional kernel enumeration of 16384 sections; 2187 rational-point-smooth sections, 18 projective orbits; exact three-chart polynomial Gröbner unit ideals select 10 smooth orbits (1512 sections). The degree-five Cartier coefficient formula yields rank H and rank H^6 for all 10 masks, giving four joint strata. A second, standard-library-only finite-field implementation counts points in extensions 1..6, reconstructs zeta numerator coefficients and independently matches every p-rank. Scope is finite and exhaustive, not extrapolated.

value.rationale: The arithmetic Jacobian rank and a-number stratification of the complete, naturally extremal genus-six binary plane-filling family is a mathematically motivated exact finite classification. It shows a sharp gap in possible 2-ranks (only 2,5,6), isolates a unique exceptional high-a-number orbit, and supplies reproducible arithmetic test cases for Cartier and p-divisible-group research. The invariant is not a renaming of the already-known geometric classification.
